positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerified
positions.frame: is the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration settled and independently verified?
positions.why: All three expressions read in the same direction: src-1 asserts the calibration state, src-2 supplies the verification method and its scope (full observing band, checked against June reference plates), and src-3 recasts both as a formal instrument-log record. The dimensional reads support treating these as one arc rather than three independent claims — affect is uniformly calm-positive/settled, register shifts from prose to technical log format across the set without changing the underlying claim, and power reads move from expert assertion (src-1) through rational-persuasion evidence (src-2) to informational record-keeping (src-3), tracing one status being established and then logged. There is a genuine conviction gradient worth naming rather than resolving: src-1 and src-2 land as defended 'claim,' while src-3's bulleted record reads as a performed 'decision' — the group holds both the asserting and the settling-into-record as part of the same calibration-status arc.
